findings: ETT.tex:889-891 (recorded, now discharged): the proof omits causal plainness, which prop:tarentin_fort_K needs (l.851). It is now PROVED for every locally Lipschitz time-oriented Lorentzian metric (Causal.LipschitzMetric.causallyPlain, via push-up, Causal.LipschitzMetric.pushUp) and hence for every Lipschitz Lorentzian manifold (IsLipschitzLorentzian.causallyPlain); the corollary follows by the printed proof (IsLipschitzLorentzian.K_lorentzien). The paper should state the regularity ('locally Lipschitz', consistent with rem:pas_plat (i), l.293, which places the threshold there) and cite plainness for it.

ETT.tex:889: 'tarentin' is not used (as recorded); absolute minimality is the gluing reading (DEC-167); strong tarentinity both ways (rem:lorentz_tarentin, l.784) is proved at Lipschitz Lorentzian manifolds by the same charts.
questions: OQ-28 under DEC-168: is 'Lorentzian manifold' in cor:K_lorentzien (and ex:causalities_lines item 5, rem:lorentz_tarentin) to be read as a time-oriented Lorentzian manifold with a locally Lipschitz metric? Reading taken: yes; the statement is proved in that reading, with no sorry and no added hypothesis beyond the reading. If the author accepts it, the row can be marked at Causal.IsLipschitzLorentzian.K_lorentzien.

The causality-level notion of manifold (charts that are causal isomorphisms onto coordinate models, the metric extended from a ball to R^{1+n} by the nearest-point retraction, timelike curves C^1): acceptable as the formal notion of a Lipschitz Lorentzian manifold? Taken: yes (it is implied by any Lipschitz Lorentzian manifold with Chruściel–Grant's causal curves; the extension and that implication are argued in SCOPE, not formalized).

kb_proposals: Lipschitz Lorentzian metrics are in the scaffold: Causal.LipschitzMetric n (locally Lipschitz Lorentzian field on Minkowski n, continuous time orientation), its causality (Lipschitz a.e.-causal paths, C^1 timelike paths), push-up, causal plainness and absolute minimality, all sorry-free (CausalScaffold.PlainnessModels.*); manifolds through charts: Causal.IsLipschitzLorentzian, with K^± = I^± (cor:K_lorentzien in the Lipschitz reading).

The shift lemma pattern (GoodBall.shift): FC at x plus μ·e is FT at y once Lg‖x−y‖‖v‖ ≤ c₁μ; with self-duality of the Lorentz cone (Lorentz.fc_of_forall_pairing_nonpos) and real FTC for Lipschitz functions (AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval.integral_deriv_eq_sub) it turns a.e. derivative bounds into chord bounds without a vector-valued FTC.
prop:K_calcul now goes through plainness (PlainnessModels.K_calcul); all its blockers are ruled (DEC-25, 150, 151, 152, 167, 168).

Defining a curve causality as ReflTransGen/TransGen of single paths avoids concatenation lemmas entirely; Lipschitz paths taken Lipschitz on all of ℝ (γ ∘ projIcc) make restriction to subintervals literal.
